item.title: How Grand Theft Auto 6 Can Be Nominated At The Game Awards Despite Not Being Out Yet
item.summary: Rockstar’s open-world crime drama scored multiple nominations, including Game of the Year
item.text:
The Game Awards just announced its 2026 nominees, and while some of the names that got repeat nods are likely not a surprise to anyone, one of them might be. Grand Theft Auto 6, a game that’s not even out yet, is the most-nominated game of the show this year. As of this writing, reviews haven’t even been published. So, in a roundabout way, some have suggested the early nominations have “spoiled” the reviews and the forthcoming reception to the game.
For those who don’t know how the Game Awards work, the nominees and winners are submitted and voted upon by a jury of media outlets (Kotaku doesn’t participate). Outlets submit ballots, the games that get the most votes are made into nominees, and the media jury then casts votes for the winners. These votes make up 90 percent of the final result. The other 10 percent is determined by a fan vote on the official Game Awards website that begins after the nominations are announced.
This year’s Game Awards cutoff allowed for all games released before November 20 to be nominated, which means that Grand Theft Auto 6, out November 19, barely slid into the eligibility window. But the nomination has still confused a lot of people because host Geoff Keighley didn’t explain the logistics of the nominating process during today’s announcement stream. It’s a rare circumstance for a game to be nominated but not officially out.
But the existence of an explanation hasn’t stopped some folks from crying foul, calling the show “rigged,” and claiming that no one has played this game yet. Some also argue that it doesn’t make sense for the player voting to be open when the game hasn’t yet been made available to the public. Maybe the Game Awards should have held off on doing the whole nominations announcement until the weekend?
Funnily enough, the Game Awards also confirmed something about GTA 6 that Rockstar Games hasn’t publicly confirmed yet. It revealed that Manny L. Perez is playing Lucia, one of the game’s protagonists. She was nominated in the Best Performance category, but hasn’t been able to publicly confirm that she’s in the game.

🏆 GTA 6 уже в числе номинантов Game Awards 2026

Игра, которой ещё нет в продаже, получила больше всех номинаций на Game Awards 2026. Это уже ставит её в ряды претендентов на «Игру года», несмотря на отсутствие отзывов. Кроме того, в категории «Лучшая актёрская игра» упомянули Люсию, озвучку которой, по данным церемонии, исполняет Мэнни П. Пэрез.
verdict.reason: Информация о номинациях подтверждена Kotaku (high), официальных заявлений нет, но факт публичен
